maddeler.e:
نتباغض (form VI)
# نَتَبَاغَضُ (natabāḡaḍu) /na.ta.baː.ɣa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# نَتَبَاغَضَ (natabāḡaḍa) /na.ta.baː.ɣa.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# نَتَبَاغَضْ (natabāḡaḍ) /na.ta.baː.ɣadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
